data.exact_reserve_text: The 2020 and prior years of account were reinsured externally via a reinsurance to close with Riverstone Syndicate 3500 in 2023. Following the reinsurance to close of 2020 and prior by Riverstone Syndicate 3500, the Syndicate currently has only three years of development to report. Capital providers will recall that the 2021 year of account was impacted materially by weather related losses (Hurricanes Ian & Ida) and geopolitical events in Ukraine.

data.standardized_narrative: Opening gross claims outstanding at 1 January 2023 were GBP 811.6m. Using the syndicate's gross claims development table, there was an adverse prior-year development of GBP 27.5m (3.39% of opening reserves) driven primarily by adverse development on the 2021 underwriting year. The movement was affected by weather-related large losses (notably hurricanes) and geopolitical impacts, and the period was materially influenced by a reinsurance-to-close transfer of 2020 & prior reserves to Syndicate 3500 which removed GBP 347.8m of prior reserves from the balance sheet.

data.data_quality_notes: Prior-year development derived from the gross claims development triangle (gross figures) which is truncated to three underwriting years due to a 2022 RITC of 2020 & prior. The RITC materially altered the reserves profile (gross transfer -347.8m) and reduces the universe of older years available for triangle comparison. The prior-year development figure (27.5m) is calculated from the triangle for the 2021 underwriting year only. Some narrative mentions net movements but gross PYD was not explicitly stated elsewhere; RITC effects noted may distort comparisons.
